subject: ophthalmology
title: Vernal Keratoconjunctivitis and Shield Ulcer

steps.tx: **Vernal keratoconjunctivitis** is severe seasonal allergic inflammation of young males in warm climates, giant cobblestone papillae under upper lid, limbal Horner Trantas dots and intense itching with ropy discharge. It recurs spring yearly and usually remit after puberty, corneal complications deciding morbidity meanwhile. Atopy history accompanies most cases though disease is more than simple allergy in severity.
steps.say: Severe seasonal allergy gives giant papillae and limbal dots in young males characteristically. Intense itching gives dominant symptom burden. Puberty gives usual remission timing.

vis.caption: Palpebral cobblestone papillae, Horner-Trantas dots, and shield ulcer in vernal keratoconjunctivitis. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: **Horner-Trantas dots** are white limbal collections of eosinophils and epithelial debris at limbus in active vernal disease, visible without eversion as gelatinous limbal thickening in limbal form. Palpebral form hides cobblestones until eversion, both forms coexisting commonly. Dots therefore allow limbal diagnosis at slit lamp while papillae need lid flip.
steps.say: White limbal collections together give active vernal evidence at slit lamp directly during clinic assessment in young patients each spring. Gelatinous limbal thickening gives limbal form recognition for examiners. Lid eversion gives palpebral form completion.

steps.tx: **Shield ulcer** is oval superior corneal epithelial defect from giant papillae mechanical abrasion and inflammatory mediators, base covered by inflammatory plaque resisting healing until plaque debrided and inflammation suppressed. It threatens vision by scarring and infection in a child whose main complaint began as itch. Shield shape and superior location are examination image phrases.
steps.say: Superior oval defect gives shield ulcer from papillae abrasion in vernal disease seriously. Plaque base gives healing resistance needing debridement. Vision threat gives escalation need.

vis.caption: Allergic severity context. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Treatment escalates mast cell and antihistamine base through immunomodulator drops to pulsed steroids for ulcers under pressure monitoring, allergen and rubbing control throughout. Eye rubbing worsens papillae mechanically and keratoconus association in vernal children needs refraction surveillance. **Rubbing cessation** is treatment instruction repeated as firmly as drop instillation technique.
steps.say: Immunomodulator escalation together gives steroid sparing control in severe vernal disease safely over repeated seasons in children. Rubbing cessation gives mechanical protection as instruction to families. Keratoconus surveillance is companion to childhood care.

steps.tx: Two signs in one frame separate vernal disease that threatens sight from vernal disease that only torments. A **shield ulcer** is a shallow corneal ulcer with a translucent base where giant papillae have rubbed the epithelium away, while Horner Trantas dots mark active limbal inflammation nearby. The ulcer heals reluctantly because inflammatory debris coats its base. Finding it moves treatment beyond ordinary allergy drops toward supervised steroids and scraping in stubborn cases.
steps.say: A shield ulcer with translucent base plus Horner Trantas dots marks sight threatening vernal disease. It heals reluctantly and moves treatment beyond ordinary allergy drops.

vis.alt: Slit lamp view of a vernal shield ulcer with translucent base, with Horner Trantas dots at the limbus.
vis.caption: A shield ulcer with a translucent base is shown on the cornea, with Horner Trantas dots along the limbus in vernal disease. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Cobblestone papillae** are giant polygonal flat topped papillae with vascular cores paving upper tarsus, distinct from smaller allergic papillae by size and mechanical corneal effect. Their weight and movement abrade superior cornea with every blink in active disease. Photophobia in vernal child therefore signals cornea, not drama, until shield ulcer excluded.
steps.say: Giant flat topped paving gives cobblestone recognition on eversion in active disease characteristically. Blink abrasion gives superior corneal effect mechanically. Photophobia gives ulcer exclusion need.

steps.tx: Atopic keratoconjunctivitis is adult counterpart with lid eczema, chronic inflammation and corneal vascularisation risk, herpes simplex susceptibility added. Vernal versus atopic split by age, lid skin and season emphasis in differential tables. **Puberty remission** expectation distinguishes vernal counselling from lifelong atopic management planning.
steps.say: Adult atopic disease gives lid eczema company with corneal risk chronically in contrast. Age and skin give vernal separation in differential. Remission expectation gives counselling difference.

steps.tx: Steroid complications in children, pressure rise and cataract, mandate lowest effective exposure and pressure checks at every pulsed course, family warned explicitly. Steroid responder children may need pressure therapy while vernal still active, parallel tracks in same clinic visit. **Pressure monitoring** is part of vernal prescription, not separate glaucoma suspicion.
steps.say: Childhood steroid exposure gives pressure and cataract monitoring need at every course safely. Responder management gives parallel track in clinic. Family warning gives explicit consent.

steps.tx: Anchors organise vernal teaching for seasonal clinics: young males itch in spring, cobblestone papillae hide under the upper lid, Trantas dots mark the limbus, and shield ulcer threatens the superior cornea. Escalation uses immunomodulators for maintenance, pulsed steroids for corneal disease, and pressure monitoring at every steroid course in children. **Photophobia means cornea** involvement in a vernal child until examination proves otherwise.
steps.say: Age together with season gives vernal recognition while lid eversion gives cobblestone confirmation simply in clinic. Corneal photophobia gives ulcer urgency in affected children always. Pressure monitoring gives steroid safety in treatment.
